pairs.question: Quare reliquis fratribus non consonaret; et quare ad accusandum, sicut aliquando fecerat, non procederet?
pairs.answer: Quod aliquando feci, inconsulto calore et contra salutem animae meae, detrahens patri meo, et more maledicti Cham, verenda patris discooperiens, operatus sum; et nunc ab errore devio me, auctore Domino, revocans, nec eum accusare, nec judicare praesumptuose, tentabo; sed pro ejus statu et incolumitate, paratus sum usque ad mortem decertare.
pairs.derivation: Caput XVI. The legate challenges Serlo of Apamea. Dropped the framing narration 'a domino legato convenitur,' which narrates the asking; kept the verbatim interrogative ('quare... non consonaret; et quare... non procederet?'), capitalizing 'Quare'. Dropped the answer's speech tag 'Respondit:'. Answer kept as the full contiguous response from 'Quod aliquando feci' through 'usque ad mortem decertare' (it answers throughout: why he formerly accused, his repentance, and his refusal now to accuse or judge); it ends at the full stop, after which the narrative resumes ('Praecipitur ergo exire...').
